verdict.rationale: Veriff's API supports the core session lifecycle an agent would need — creating sessions, polling decisions, receiving webhooks, and triggering test-integration decisions — which covers create/poll/re-check style operations, but there is no evidence of an MCP server/surface, no scoped-credential model for agent-specific access (only HMAC shared-secret auth for whole integrations), and no explicit 'retrieve extracted data' endpoint documentation beyond decision/webhook payloads. missing for 10: MCP surface or agent-oriented interface, scoped/least-privilege credential support for agents, explicit extracted-data retrieval endpoint, independent confirmation of agent-driven usage.
